about.title: Scans That Turn Into Decisions

services.title: Turn field data into actionable decisions
services.desc: Turn your crop's nutritional status and microclimates into clear instructions: what to apply, how much, and exactly where. Optimize fertilization and irrigation with real-time decisions generated by our autonomous system.

faq_items.title: How does the system work?
faq_items.desc: Think of a small cart that drives itself through your farm, takes photos of every cacao pod, and tells you in minutes if any are sick or how many are ready to harvest. That's Airix: a rover that walks your rows, sees what you can't watch all the time, and sends a report straight to your phone.

faq_items.title: Do I need to be tech-savvy to use it?
faq_items.desc: Not at all. Our team comes to your farm, sets everything up from day one, and walks you through reading the report. After that, you just open the app and see which areas are fine, which need attention, and what to do next. Think of it as a WhatsApp message with the status of your field.

faq_items.title: How long does it take to get results?
faq_items.desc: The rover covers about one hectare every 2 hours. When it's done, your report is ready in minutes, right in the app. No waiting days or sending samples to a lab.

faq_items.title: What exactly does the report tell me?
faq_items.desc: It tells you how many pods are healthy, which ones show signs of disease like Monilia or Phytophthora, which areas of your farm are at risk, and how much you're likely to harvest that month. All in plain language, no jargon.

faq_items.title: What's inside the rover? (technical specs)
faq_items.desc: High-resolution RGB cameras for disease detection and pod counting. LiDAR for autonomous navigation between plants. Temperature and humidity sensors to record microclimates. Speed: 0.5 m/s. Coverage: up to 9 ha/day. Row spacing: 3 m. Works offline and syncs data when it returns to a signal zone.

about_page.purpose_text: We exist to transform the lives of farmers by giving them accessible technology that allows them to grow more efficiently, care for the land, and produce more food. We want every harvest to strengthen their homes and reach everyone's table, ensuring a fair price for those who need it most.
about_page.mission_text: We help farmers better care for their crops and increase their output by giving them affordable technology that saves them money. Many small farmers lose harvests or fail to make the most of their land because they cannot afford expensive solutions. We want to change that — making our technology available to all so they can produce food at competitive prices and improve their land.
about_page.vision_text: The world we aspire to build is one where every person can live with dignity and access enough food, harnessing technology to produce more efficiently in less space, reducing resource consumption, and promoting sustainable agriculture.

items.title: Field Scanning & Monitoring
items.desc: Use your mobile, drone, or multispectral sensors to capture data from your farm. Airix processes the imagery and delivers plant counts, disease detection, and production volume projections directly from the field.

items.title: Early Disease Detection
items.desc: Our computer vision models identify early signs of phytosanitary diseases in cacao before they spread. Act in time and protect your harvest with automatic alerts by risk zone.

items.title: Yield Estimation
items.desc: Count cacao pods and estimate expected production per lot or plot. Plan harvest logistics, negotiate with buyers, and optimize resources with projections based on real field data.

items.title: Field Variability Maps
items.desc: Generate spatial maps of your farm with crop health variability, plant density, and risk zones. Identify where to intervene first and distribute inputs with greater precision.

items.title: Real-Time Actionable Decisions
items.desc: Turn your crop's nutritional status and microclimates into clear instructions: what to apply, how much, and exactly where. Optimize fertilization and irrigation with real-time decisions generated by our autonomous system.
